items.prompt: Does an acquire operation on an unrelated atomic automatically publish all prior writes from any thread?

options.text: No; the atomic and observed value matter
options.why: Release/acquire keywords alone are not a global publication proof.

options.text: Yes, regardless of object or observed value
Yes, as long as the acquire load reads any value from its own atomic
options.why: The acquire must connect to the relevant release or release sequence on the same atomic; an arbitrary value does not establish unrelated publication.

options.text: Yes, and it proves object lifetimes never end

items.explanation: Publication must trace a real synchronization path and valid object lifetimes.
